reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets small business owners with calm, practical framing and respects all boundaries, though it slips into first-person singular ('I') instead of Bareni's standard public voice ('we').
reasons.clarity: The reasoning is exceptionally clear, logically ordered, and plain-spoken, articulating why testing assumptions matters before building.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, concrete one-page scoping test and decision heuristic tailored specifically for small business owner-operators without any pushy CTA.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to Bareni evidence; accurately references delivery policies without overpromising, invents no customers or results, and upholds mandatory human approval.
